metric_priority.name: protocol_gauc
metric_priority.definition: Weighted user-level AUC under the active protocol. For event transfer this is rolling-dev GAUC; for local reranking this is same-user local user-pair GAUC.

metric_priority.name: protocol_macro_user_auc
metric_priority.definition: Unweighted mean of valid user AUC values under the active protocol.

metric_priority.name: global_auc_risk
metric_priority.definition: Cross-user event-level AUC. It is recorded as a score-comparability risk, not as a veto against a valid same-user reranker improvement.

minimum_reporting_requirements: mean metrics across all rolling folds
multi-seed stability when training is stochastic
seed win rate versus current formal champion
H2/E0, zero EEG, and shuffle EEG controls
explicit statement whether 0.8 AUC is reached
